purpose: Bounded offline final-list recombination; not live retrieval or independent evaluation
inputs: PATCH-015 final law TOP5 plus PATCH-016 civil RRF TOP7 for the same 235 inputs
fusion: score = 1/(5+baseline_rank) + civil_weight/(5+civil_rank); absent contribution is zero
tie_break: existing baseline rank first, then normalized article identifier
technical_gate: For both K values: no loss of any previously returned required article in nonhistorical DEV inputs or CIV primary29, and strictly higher primary29 AllRequired count than baseline. A pass is only eligibility for later runtime and boundary review, not deployment approval.
unscored: Historical DEV, targetless queries and CIV scope-provisional remain reported separately; no automatic failure or success labels.
stop_rule: Report all three variants and accept/reject the technical gate without adding weights or changing gold after observing results.
